functions.name: is_admin
functions.rationale: Checks if $_SESSION['privilege'] == 'admin'. Core role-based authorization function used throughout the app. Called by require_admin(), header.php for conditional menu display, and comments.php for moderation UI.

functions.name: require_admin
functions.rationale: Authorization gate: terminates with error if is_admin() returns false. Called in comments.php:46 to protect comment moderation (delete/approve). Hard enforcement of admin-only operations.

functions.name: require_loggedin
functions.rationale: Authentication gate: terminates with error if getEmail() returns FALSE (user not logged in). Called in comments.php:77 before comment submission. Ensures only authenticated users can post.
